note: The crag's people are tools/worlds/homelands.json's (South Barren Coast): Elder Gorrak gives the first two, Talonmaster Krall beside him the three hunts; Hidecutter Vess (east of the elder, atop the crag) is the outfitter; Coachman Durn keeps the stable at the crag's foot to the west, beside the grocer, so that a rider lands on the ground. The crag bats are round the crag's foot to the south-west, the cragside skinks on the barrens east of the crag, the sand-thing Grindstone alone on the flats to the north.

L1.name: A Band for the Woken
offer: So. Another of us has woken from the stone. Every gargoyle of this crag wears a band set with a chip of the rock it woke on, so it does not forget where it stood.
Hidecutter Vess cuts them. She stands a few paces east of here, on the crag's top.
Will you fetch your band and show it to me?
L1.declined: Stone is patient. So am I.
L1.started: Go. Vess is a few paces east of here.

piece.name: stonewake band
piece.description: A band of crag-lizard hide set with a chip of the roost's own rock. Every newly woken gargoyle of the crag wears one.

fetch.journal: Ask Hidecutter Vess, east of Elder Gorrak atop the crag, for a stonewake band.
fetch.says: Gorrak sent you. Hold out your arm. Hide from the barrens, a chip of the crag you woke on. The newly woken pay nothing.

show.journal: Show the stonewake band to Elder Gorrak.
show.says: Good. Wear it. Wherever you roost, a piece of this crag roosts with you.

L2.name: Bound to the Crag
offer: Stone breaks, wakeling, when it falls far enough. Have Spiritmaster Vorth bind your spirit to the crag, so that you wake here again if you shatter.
Then go down to Coachman Durn at the crag's foot, and give him your name for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
L2.declined: Then keep away from the edge.
L2.started: Vorth stands just north of here. Durn waits below, at the foot of the crag to the west, by the grocer.

bind.journal: Have Spiritmaster Vorth, north of the elder atop the crag, bind your spirit to the crag.
bind.says: It is done. Should you shatter, you will wake here on the crag. Now go down and give Coachman Durn your name.

ledger.journal: Give your name to Coachman Durn, at the foot of the crag to the west, for his ledger.
ledger.says: Welcome to my stable, wakeling. My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

back.journal: Climb back to Elder Gorrak atop the crag.
says: Good. You know the way down and the way back up. Remember both.
Durn's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the sky to Oggok is earned. Talonmaster Krall, beside me, has work for you.

L3.name: Bats Round the Crag
offer: You are the one newly woken. Good. Crag bats nest in the rocks round the foot of our crag, to the south-west, and their screeching keeps the sleepers from their stone.
Silence them and bring me three of their wings. Then I will teach you something worth knowing.
Will you hunt them?
L3.declined: Then the sleepers will not rest.
L3.started: Three wings. Strike before they scatter.

drop.name: crag bat wing
drop.description: The leathery wing of a crag bat from the foot of the gargoyles' crag.

hunt.journal: Take three crag bat wings from the crag bats round the foot of the crag, to the south-west.

give.journal: Bring three crag bat wings to Talonmaster Krall atop the crag.
give.says: Three wings, and no chip out of you. You can fight. Now watch, and learn this.

L4.name: A Wakeling's Arms
offer: Blunt claws will not serve you among the ogres. I will make you proper gear, but you will fetch what I need.
Hidecutter Vess has a hide thong and a good shaft for me. Then take a tail from the cragside skinks on the barrens east of the crag.
Will you bring me all three?
L4.declined: Then keep to your claws, and to your ledge.
L4.started: A thong and a shaft from Vess, a tail from the skinks. Go.

items.name: crag-hide thong
items.description: A thong cut from crag-lizard hide by the hidecutters of the gargoyles' roost.

materials.journal: Ask Hidecutter Vess for the crag-hide thong and the wooden shaft.
materials.says: For Krall. Here: a thong of hide and a straight shaft. Wood is scarce on the barrens. Do not break it.

drop.name: cragside skink tail
drop.description: The thick tail of a cragside skink from the barrens east of the gargoyles' crag.

hunt.journal: Take a cragside skink tail from the cragside skinks on the barrens east of the crag.

give.journal: Bring the crag-hide thong, the wooden shaft and the cragside skink tail to Talonmaster Krall.
give.says: All three. Wait... there. It is yours. Stone made it: do not shame it.

L5.name: Grindstone
offer: One task more before the sky is yours. A thing of crumbling sand walks the flats north of the crag. We call it Grindstone. It has ground two sleepers to grit.
It walks alone, and it comes for anything of stone. Break it and bring me its core, and I will teach you the last thing I have for a wakeling.
Will you hunt Grindstone?
L5.declined: It grinds on while you wait.
L5.started: Down the crag and north across the flats. Do not let it close its arms on you.

drop.name: Grindstone's core
drop.description: The hard knot of rock at the heart of the sand-thing Grindstone.

hunt.journal: Take Grindstone's core from the sand-thing Grindstone on the flats north of the crag.

give.journal: Bring Grindstone's core to Talonmaster Krall atop the crag.
says: Grindstone's core. The sleepers are safe in their stone. You are a wakeling no longer.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Kragg on the south slope when you are ready for Oggok.

flight.name: Wings to Oggok
offer: The sky is clear to Tunaria. The ogres of Oggok gave us the crags above their city to roost on, and they will train you as their own.
You have earned the passage, wakeling. I will set you down among your own guild in Oggok, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you to Oggok?
flight.declined: The crag will wait for you.
flight.started: Stand firm in Oggok, and guard it well!
flight.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Kragg when you are ready to fly to Oggok.

L7.name: Grit for the Mortar
offer: Stone does not feel the cold, wakeling. Go and prove it. The homes keep a hunters' outpost under the Goldfeather Eyrie, and Durn's coach runs there.
Drift rat teeth, ground fine, make the mortar we mend the crag's cracks with. Bring me three from the snow east of the outpost.
Will you bring me the teeth?
L7.started: Durn's coach will take you. Do not stand still too long out there.

drop.name: drift rat incisor
drop.description: A yellow gnawing tooth from a drift rat of the Goldfeather Eyrie's snow.

hunt.journal: Take three drift rat incisors from the drift rats east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring three drift rat incisors to Talonmaster Krall.
give.says: Three teeth. Hard ones. The crag will hold another winter. Now watch, and learn this.

L10.name: A Fang Set in Stone
offer: Your arms are a wakeling's. I will make you a guardian's weapon, with a rime spider's fang set in it, hard as frost.
A thong from Hidecutter Vess, ore from Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost, two fangs from the rime spiders north-east of it.
Will you bring me all of it?
L10.declined: Then strike harder with what you have.

items.name: crag-hide thong
items.description: A thong cut from crag-lizard hide by the hidecutters of the gargoyles' roost.

materials.journal: Ask Hidecutter Vess on the crag for a crag-hide thong.
materials.says: Another thong for Krall. Here. Hide is scarce on the barrens: bring this one home on the weapon.

materials.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost for the ore Krall needs.
materials.says: One of the crag's? Your folk stood my wall a whole night once and never blinked. Here, the ore, and welcome.

drop.name: rime spider fang
drop.description: A fang of clear, frosted chitin from a rime spider of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take two rime spider fangs from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the crag-hide thong, the iron ore and the rime spider fangs to Talonmaster Krall.
give.says: Ore, hide and fang. Wait... there. It is yours. Stone made it, and frost hardened it: do not shame it.

L13.name: The Leopard at the Stones
offer: An old snow leopard they call Old Frostjaw hunts the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost. He sharpens his claws on the standing stones there.
A gargoyle does not let stone be scored. Break his jaw and bring me his fang. Take others with you: he is old, and old means clever.
Will you bring me Old Frostjaw's fang?
L13.declined: Then the stones take the scoring.
L13.started: He strikes first. Stand firm and let him break on you.

drop.name: Old Frostjaw's fang
drop.description: A long yellowed fang of the snow leopard Old Frostjaw.

hunt.journal: Take Old Frostjaw's fang from the old snow leopard on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring Old Frostjaw's fang to Talonmaster Krall.
give.says: His fang. It will be set in the crag beside the sleepers, so they know a guardian woke among them. Learn this.

L15.name: Cold That Cracks Stone
offer: There is a cold in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost that cracks stone. The hunters call it the Rimeheart. A sleeper that wakes too near it will never wake again.
Break it. Carry a shard to Warden Halvek, so the outpost knows its watch is safe. Then come back.
Will you break the Rimeheart?
L15.started: Not alone. Even stone breaks alone.

drop.name: shard of the Rimeheart
drop.description: A shard of blue ice that never melts, broken from the Rimeheart.

hunt.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

carry.journal: Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
carry.says: The Rimeheart, broken by one of the crag's. My watch sleeps easier, and so do I. Tell Krall the Eyrie owes his crag.

back.says: Halvek's word came before you did. Good. You stood where stone cracks and did not. Learn this.

L20.name: The Guardian's Watch
offer: Krall says you stand like a guardian now. Before a gargoyle of the crag chooses its path, it stands guard for the homes we share the land with.
Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost needs a guardian on his wall. Go to him, do as he asks, and come back to me.
Will you stand guard at the Eyrie?
L20.declined: Then the wall stands without you.

road.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: Gorrak's guardian? Good. A wall needs stone. The raiders round the eyrie east of here test mine every night: bring me three of their war-talons.

drop.name: Goldfeather war-talon
drop.description: A war-talon of the Goldfeather aviaks, bound in gold thread.

hunt.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.

handin.journal: Bring the three war-talons to Warden Halvek.
handin.says: Three talons. They will test someone else's wall now. Ask Scout Feyla up the river if the eyrie has gone quiet.

after.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
after.says: Quiet as stone up there. Not a raider in the air. Go home, guardian: your elder waits for you.

final.journal: Return to Elder Gorrak on the crag.
final.says: You left a wakeling and came back a guardian every home knows. The crag has one more thing to give you.
